$comment: The workspace packages published to npm as @alethialabs/<name> (docs/contributing/releasing-packages.md). Inside the monorepo they keep their @repo/* names; scripts/release/stage-public-packages.mjs renames them only in the staged copy that is published. A published package may depend only on other published packages. `shipSource` also ships src/ for packages whose source a consumer's Tailwind must scan. `omitExports` are workspace-only entry points that are deliberately not published.
